hero.subtitle: Local-first AI platform for document management, semantic search, and multi-provider LLM chat. Privacy-focused, self-hosted, open source.
features.title: Key Features
features.subtitle: Everything you need for local AI-powered document management
feature.chat.title: Multi-Provider Chat
feature.chat.desc: Seamlessly switch between Ollama, OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google Gemini. Local-first with cloud fallback.
feature.search.title: Semantic Search
feature.search.desc: Vector-powered search with Qdrant. Find documents by meaning, not just keywords.
feature.docs.title: Document Intelligence
feature.docs.desc: Upload, chunk, and index PDF, DOCX, TXT files. Automatic folder monitoring with Spring Batch.
feature.mcp.title: MCP Integration
feature.mcp.desc: 132+ native tools via Model Context Protocol. Connect external servers for extended capabilities.
feature.security.title: Security & Auth
feature.security.desc: JWT authentication, rate limiting, input validation, and comprehensive audit logging.
feature.webhooks.title: Webhooks & Automation
feature.webhooks.desc: Event-driven webhooks for document indexing, chat completion, and scheduled tasks.
